patterns.name: NETWORK_CRYPTO_REGRESSION
patterns.level_meaning: several related changes in one window that a single change cannot explain
patterns.why: negotiated cryptography weakened on an endpoint: a lower protocol, a weaker suite, a replaced certificate or a moved trust anchor
not_proven: that anything was attacked: a downgrade, a replacement certificate, a new listener and a new process are facts about configuration and timing, and the combination raises review priority rather than establishing a cause
that the endpoint is compromised, or that its cryptography was intercepted
who did it, or whether it was done at all: no actor, no motive and no external intelligence take part in this correlation
that the window is complete: changes outside it, or inside a plane nobody collected, are invisible here
the endpoint may be serving the same policy as before; what moved is what the handshake showed
patterns.next_action: compare against the change record for the terminating device and confirm the weaker setting was intended

patterns.name: TRUST_PATH_SHIFT
patterns.level_meaning: several related changes in one window that a single change cannot explain
patterns.why: the protocol or suite weakened and the certificate was replaced on the same endpoint inside one window — the two facts that together describe a trust path
not_proven: that anything was attacked: a downgrade, a replacement certificate, a new listener and a new process are facts about configuration and timing, and the combination raises review priority rather than establishing a cause
that the endpoint is compromised, or that its cryptography was intercepted
who did it, or whether it was done at all: no actor, no motive and no external intelligence take part in this correlation
that the window is complete: changes outside it, or inside a plane nobody collected, are invisible here
a renewal and an interception look the same from outside; only the PKI and the device logs separate them
patterns.next_action: confirm with the PKI owner that the certificate was renewed, and with the platform owner that the weaker protocol is a deliberate fallback

patterns.name: NEW_EXPOSURE
patterns.level_meaning: a change worth a look: it weakened evidence, appeared unexpectedly, or lost coverage
patterns.why: a listener appeared that no earlier snapshot contained; a new listener needs an owner before it needs a verdict
not_proven: that anything was attacked: a downgrade, a replacement certificate, a new listener and a new process are facts about configuration and timing, and the combination raises review priority rather than establishing a cause
that the endpoint is compromised, or that its cryptography was intercepted
who did it, or whether it was done at all: no actor, no motive and no external intelligence take part in this correlation
that the window is complete: changes outside it, or inside a plane nobody collected, are invisible here
a listener can be a collector seeing an endpoint it missed before, rather than a new service
patterns.next_action: assign the listener to an owner and confirm it was provisioned

patterns.why: several independent network signals coincide in one window: CERTIFICATE_MUTATION, NEW_ENDPOINT, NEW_PROCESS, TLS_DOWNGRADE. A downgrade alone is a fact, and a new process alone is a fact; together they describe one event rather than four
not_proven: that anything was attacked: a downgrade, a replacement certificate, a new listener and a new process are facts about configuration and timing, and the combination raises review priority rather than establishing a cause
that the endpoint is compromised, or that its cryptography was intercepted
who did it, or whether it was done at all: no actor, no motive and no external intelligence take part in this correlation
that the window is complete: changes outside it, or inside a plane nobody collected, are invisible here
coincidence in one window is also what a maintenance window, a failover and a certificate renewal look like
patterns.next_action: open one investigation covering the listed subjects and evidence ids, and confirm or dismiss each signal separately — do not treat the combination as a single finding

limits: one window is one comparison. An attacker who waits longer than the window, or who changes nothing a collector can see, produces no pattern — an empty result is not a clean estate
the window is anchored on the newest signal in the set, so the same stored changes always correlate the same way; widening it finds more coincidence as well as more pattern
a certificate replacement is indistinguishable from an interception without the PKI's own record, so the pattern points at the PKI owner instead of deciding
a new process is attributed to the host it was observed on, not to the application that started it; process-level evidence is guide 146's job
the ceiling is level 2. The platform reserves level 4 for combinations it can corroborate across independent planes, and one network window is one plane
no external intelligence, no actor and no motive take part. The output is a review queue with evidence ids, not an incident
